metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-qp[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Ref Cards[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every library reference note opens on a calm, information-dense Ref[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Card in the Property Card family. The card answers what the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reference is, where it came from, where Bryan is with it, and what [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]useful material it holds, and it omits whatever a note lacks. `==` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]opens a bob-owned Reference editor. bob protects reference sync and[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]identity keys from generic edits. The work ships beside bob-cli-qm [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and touches it only at named seams.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]ref_cards.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/ref_cards.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-qp[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-qp/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob props reference roles and the Reference contract[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ref-props[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-props: scope the reference note kind to bob's library coverage, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]protect sync, identity, and reading-task keys (resolving bob-cli-qn), [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and add the bob-owned reference settings contract. It also adds the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]props_ref_contract_v1 capability and the conditional H1 retitle, with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs and tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Ref species kit, preview gate, vocabulary, and scaffolding[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ref-kit[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-kit: owns every shared-kit edit. Adds the ref species with the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ribbon tile, the silent created stamp, a coordinator kind, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]precedence slot after prose with the exhaustive test, a ref-owned [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]preview gate, and one shared ref vocabulary that the Reading Board also [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]uses. Also adds fragment stubs, fixtures, a docs stub, and coordination [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notes on qm.6 and qm.7.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shared ref-library report service[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ref-service[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-service: one lazily subscribed, stale-while-revalidate `bob ref list[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]-A -R all -f json` snapshot indexed by path and shared by every mounted [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]card. It uses narrow, debounced revalidation triggers and never spawns [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]from paint.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Ref Card shell from local identity[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ref-card[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-kit[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-card: the pure identity model and the DOM. The host mounts behind [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the gate and precedence. The card owns the title with matching-H1 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]adoption and gets the byline, access chips, foot, Managed drawer, `_` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]compact, and `==` focus-or-add on title. The docs page body comes in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]this phase.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reading-state readouts from the shared snapshot[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ref-readouts[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-card, ref-service[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-readouts: subscribe cards to the shared snapshot. Patch the lane [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chip, Today pill, annotations, reread lineage, identifiers, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]diagnostics into existing rows with no layout shift. Spy tests prove [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]there are no spawns.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The Reference editor behind ==[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ref-editor[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-card, ref-props[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-editor: `==` opens the shared Property Editor on bob's REFERENCE [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contract. It has editable citation rows and owned-elsewhere rows that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]route reading state, residence, and file name to their owners. It probes[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the capability and falls back to title focus-or-add.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Real-Obsidian acceptance and screenshot review[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ref-acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-readouts, ref-editor[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-acceptance: after bob-cli-qm.6 closes, extend the takeover harness [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]as a sibling runner. Prove takeover, single ownership, native [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]restoration, passivity, data, and editor flows. Review the light, dark, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]narrow, wide, forced-colors, and grayscale screenshot matrix beside the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]other family cards.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Switch Ref Cards on, docs, approved memory, and clean deploy[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ref-go-live[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ref-acceptance[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-go-live: after bob-cli-qm.7 closes, delete the ref preview gate, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]extend the passive proof, and finish the docs in both repos. Apply only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the accepted memory decisions, then deploy clean with provenance.[/#D7D7AF]

commits.subject: feat(props): add Reference contract and roles
